nodes.label: first reply
nodes.instruction:
Find the lead in BE Direct, or create it. Read the whole thread first and answer everything they've sent in one reply.
If the enquiry already says what they need (how many people need a phone, their current numbers, whether to keep them, when they want it working), don't ask: report has_details.
Otherwise write a short, friendly email: thank them by first name, say what we'll quote, and ask 3 or 4 short questions that can each be answered in one line (how many people need a phone, how many numbers they have now, do they want to keep those numbers, when they want it working). Say they can just reply, or give a time that suits and we'll call.
Sign off as "Jimmy, BE Direct". Never claim to be a person. Send it for approval.
nodes.success: The lead exists in BE Direct and the customer has our reply, or the enquiry already has everything we need.

results.name: replied
results.meaning: our reply with the questions was sent

results.name: has_details
results.meaning: the enquiry already says what they need

results.name: declined
results.meaning: they're not interested, said not now, or asked not to be contacted

nodes.label: read their answers
nodes.instruction:
They wrote back. Read everything new in the thread and save their answers to the lead.
If we now know what they need, report has_details.
If some questions are still open, reply once with just those (for approval) and report more_needed.
If they're not interested, said not now, or asked not to be contacted, report declined.
nodes.success: Their answers are on the lead, and anything still open has been asked once.

results.name: more_needed
results.meaning: we asked for what's still missing

results.name: declined
results.meaning: not interested, not now, or don't contact

nodes.label: check, then call
nodes.instruction:
Check the mailbox first. If they replied, report replied.
Only one call per enquiry: if called is yes, or they gave no phone number, send one short follow-up email with the questions still open (for approval) and report emailed.
Otherwise ask for approval to call with BE Voice (place_call):
- goal: get the details for their quote, or agreement to send one
- greeting: "Hi {first name}, it's Jimmy from BE Direct, calling about the quote you asked for. Have you got two minutes?"
- questions: the questions still open, plus email address if we don't have it
- human: {salesperson mobile}, for anyone who wants a person
- max_call_sec: 300
- context: what they asked for in their enquiry
- prompt: "You are a friendly caller for BE Direct. The customer asked us for a quote. Ask the questions briefly. If they're busy, offer to call back at a time that suits. If they'd rather do it by email, agree and end the call. If they say no or not interested, thank them and end politely. Never make up prices, discounts or deadlines. At the end of the call, note one of: details given, wants a callback (and when), just email me, declined, or no answer. Summarise what they said about staff numbers, phone numbers and timing."
Wait with wait_for_call; if the summary is blank, check get_call a minute later. Save the outcome, answers and summary to the lead, and save called = yes.
If they want it by email, send one short email with the questions still open (for approval) and report emailed. If they booked a callback, tell {salesperson} the time and report callback_booked.
nodes.success: Either they had replied, or we called once and the outcome is saved on the lead, or one follow-up email went out.

results.name: details_given
results.meaning: the call got the details, or they agreed to a quote

results.name: emailed
results.meaning: no phone, already called, or they want email: one follow-up email was sent

results.name: callback_booked
results.meaning: they want a call back at a set time

results.name: declined
results.meaning: they said no or not interested

nodes.label: callback by the salesperson
nodes.question: The customer asked for a call back; the time is in the run's history. Call them, then say how it went.

nodes.label: make and send the quote
nodes.instruction: Make the quote in BE Direct as a draft today, following your proposal instructions, and send it for approval. Once a person approves, send it to the customer. Save the proposal number.
nodes.success: The customer has the approved quote.

nodes.label: follow-up 1
nodes.instruction:
Check the mailbox and BE Direct first. If the proposal is accepted, report accepted.
Otherwise send one short follow-up for approval: "Did the quote arrive OK? Happy to walk you through it." Note follow-up 1 of 4 on the lead. Never invent urgency, discounts or deadlines; only mention the quote's real valid-until date.
nodes.success: They've accepted, or follow-up 1 was sent and noted on the lead.

nodes.label: follow-up 2
nodes.instruction:
Check the mailbox and BE Direct first. If the proposal is accepted, report accepted.
Otherwise send one short follow-up for approval that answers the likely question: what's included, how porting works, no lock-in on the monthly term. Note follow-up 2 of 4 on the lead. Never invent urgency, discounts or deadlines.
nodes.success: They've accepted, or follow-up 2 was sent and noted on the lead.

nodes.label: follow-up 3
nodes.instruction:
Check the mailbox and BE Direct first. If the proposal is accepted, report accepted.
Otherwise send one short follow-up for approval offering a 10-minute call with {salesperson}. Note follow-up 3 of 4 on the lead. Never invent urgency, discounts or deadlines.
nodes.success: They've accepted, or follow-up 3 was sent and noted on the lead.

nodes.label: last follow-up
nodes.instruction:
Check the mailbox and BE Direct first. If the proposal is accepted, report accepted.
Otherwise send one last short email for approval: "I'll close this off for now. Just reply any time to pick it back up." Note follow-up 4 of 4 on the lead and tell {salesperson} it went quiet.
nodes.success: They've accepted, or the last follow-up was sent and {salesperson} knows.

nodes.label: answer their reply
nodes.instruction:
They wrote back about the quote. Check the mailbox and BE Direct.
If they accepted, report accepted.
If they asked questions, answer every one first, then ask if they're happy to go ahead (for approval), and report answered.
If an answer changes the price, report price_changed (don't send the old quote again).
If they're not interested, said not now, or asked not to be contacted, report declined.
nodes.success: Every question they asked is answered, or the next step is clear.

results.name: declined
results.meaning: not interested, not now, or don't contact

nodes.label: revise the quote
nodes.instruction: Update the proposal's text and price in BE Direct and send it for approval. Once approved, send the new version. A changed proposal can't be accepted until it's sent again.
nodes.success: The customer has the latest approved revision.

nodes.label: won
nodes.instruction:
The proposal is accepted. Thank them, and tell {salesperson} straight away with the proposal number and the monthly and one-off totals.
Ask by email (for approval) for: business name and ABN, billing contact and email, current phone provider and account number (for the number port), who needs a phone (names and emails), preferred go-live date.
Mark the lead Won in BE Direct and note the go-live date. Hand the rest to {salesperson}: setup, port forms and the welcome call.
nodes.success: The lead is Won, {salesperson} knows, and the customer was asked for the setup details.

nodes.label: declined
nodes.instruction:
Stop all follow-ups.
If they asked not to be contacted, note it on the lead, mark it Lost and report lost.
Otherwise ask once, politely, for the reason (price, timing, chose someone else) for approval, note it on the lead, and mark the lead Lost.
If they said not now, note the month they gave and tell {salesperson}, then report not_now.
nodes.success: The lead is marked Lost with the reason, or not now is noted with the month.

nodes.label: close off
nodes.instruction: We couldn't reach them. If we tried to call, send one short email (for approval) saying we tried to call and they can reply any time. Message {salesperson} with the call summary or what happened. Note it on the lead.
nodes.success: {salesperson} knows, and the lead says why it stopped.
